name: Simply Login Register
author: Anshul Gangrade

sections.description:
Simply Login Register is an easy way to create a modern login, register, lost password, and user profile page using simple shortcodes or native Page Builder blocks.

Shortcodes included:

  • [slr_login] – Outputs an AJAX-powered Login Form.
  • [slr_register] – Outputs an AJAX-powered Registration Form with password strength meter.
  • [slr_lost_password] – Outputs a Lost Password recovery form.
  • [slr_profile] – Outputs a Frontend User Profile update form.

New Features in Version 3.0!

  • Native Page Builder Support: Includes widgets and blocks for Elementor, WPBakery, and Gutenberg so you can just drag-and-drop the forms into your page visually!
  • Spam Protection: Built-in Google reCAPTCHA v2 support for the registration form.
  • Custom Redirects: Set specific redirect URLs after Login, Registration, Password Reset, and Profile Update in the plugin settings.
  • Customization: Easily change the submit button colors directly from the settings panel.
  • Improved UI/UX: Show/Hide password toggles and a live password strength indicator.
sections.installation:
1. Upload category-post-slider.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Unzip simply-login-register.zip
  3. Activate the plugin through the \’Plugins\’ menu in WordPress
  4. You will find \’simply login register settings\’ under setting menu in your WordPress admin panel.
sections.changelog:
3.0

  • Major Update!
  • Feature: Added Lost Password form and shortcode [slr_lost_password].
  • Feature: Added Frontend Profile Settings form and shortcode [slr_profile].
  • Feature: Added Native Page Builder widgets for Gutenberg, Elementor, and WPBakery.
  • Feature: Added reCAPTCHA v2 integration for spam protection.
  • Feature: Added options to set Custom Redirect URLs.
  • Enhancement: Added Password visibility toggles (eye icon) and password strength meter.
  • Enhancement: Complete rewrite of the settings panel with customizable form button colors.

2.1

  • Version 2.1 – December 25, 2023
  • Enhancement: Enable support up to WordPress 6.4.2

2.0

  • Version 2.0
  • Issue: Fixed bugs
  • Inhancement: Make proper working on wordpress 4.9.4

1.0

  • Version 1.0
  • Initial version.
